name: POS Sales Report
purpose: Totals sales for each store, cashier and payment method across the fiscal quarter

inputs.fiscal_period: Fiscal quarter the sale is reported in
inputs.transaction_id: ID of the receipt the line belongs to
inputs.line_position: Position of the line on the receipt, e.g. line 2 of 3
inputs.transaction_time: Date and time of the sale
inputs.cashier: Name of the cashier who rang up the sale
inputs.line_total: Amount charged for the line after discount
inputs.payment_method: How the customer paid, e.g. cash or card
inputs.customer_phone: Mobile number of the loyalty customer
